ambiguities.fragment: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key
ambiguities.explanation: The logical operator precedence is underspecified. It is unclear whether the condition requires all three events to occur simultaneously (AND) or if the system should trigger on any single event (OR), specifically regarding the relationship between window damage and the intruder detection/door opening events.
possible_interpretations: The alarm triggers only if all three conditions are met simultaneously: (1) window damage, (2) intruder detection, AND (3) door opened without key.
The alarm triggers if any one of the following occurs: (1) window damage AND intruder detection, OR (2) door opened without key.
textual_evidence: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key
context_evidence: Alarm must be raised when either intruder detection occurs, or a door is opened without key, and window damage is confirmed.
